extractions.description: Introduces and empirically evaluates the MR.Q model-free deep reinforcement-learning procedure, together with multiple baselines and design variants, on Gym locomotion, DeepMind Control Suite, and Atari environments.

type.quote: We evaluate our method, MR.Q, on four widely used RL benchmarks and 118 environments
type.justification: The paper trains and evaluates agents, baselines, and ablations numerically, so it is empirical.

name.justification: The paper explicitly frames its contribution as advancing general-purpose model-free deep reinforcement learning.
The proposed method advances dynamics/model-based representation learning within a model-free agent.
Continuous-control robotics tasks are used as evaluation settings.
Visual control is an evaluation domain rather than the central research contribution.
MR.Q denotes the learned agent evaluated throughout the paper.
